blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals into advantage estimation. At the session level, it shapes each session's advantage according to the estimated marginal contribution. Experiments on BrowseComp with Qwen3.5-4B show that Mosaic outperforms broadcasting in both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios while using fewer sessions on average. Further analyses show that our method achieves improvements in session utility and allocation, which we suggested is a promising target for future advances in multi-session agentic RL.
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的代理强化学习方法都假设单会场轨迹,相互作用在一个不断积累的背景下进行。 然而,上下文收缩和分试剂等代理技术可能会产生跨越多个会话的轨迹,造成单会话培训假设和推断时间执行之间的不匹配. 因此,我们引入了多场会议代理强化学习,这是一种较一般性的环境,支持在轨迹范围内任意举行多场会议。 在这种背景下,一种被广泛采用的方法是向所有会话播放出轨迹级的优点,但这并不区分各种会话的贡献或在轨迹内的指导会话分配. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出Mosaic,一种多会场代理RL方法,无评论分级优化. 在轨迹一级,它将会议使用信号纳入优势估计。 在会议一级,它根据估计的边际贡献来决定每届会议的优势。 在使用Quen3.5-4B的浏览器Comp上的实验显示,Mosaic在上下文收缩和子剂烘焙两种情景中都超过了广播,同时平均使用较少的会话. 进一步的分析表明,我们的方法在会议效用和分配方面有所改进,我们建议,这是今后在多会议代理软件方面取得进展的一个有希望的目标。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agentic Reinforcement Learning ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 , Agentic RL;) trains Large Language Model (LLM) agents ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) for multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external environments via online rollouts and reward feedback, yielding broad performance gains. More recently, LLM agents have incorporated advanced inference techniques, such as context management ( Mei et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) and harness engineering ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , enabling agentic workflows to tackle increasingly complex and long-horizon tasks. However, most agentic RL methods assume a single-session setting, where each rollout unfolds as a coherent multi-turn trajectory within a continuously accumulated context and yields a single training segment ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 代理强化学习(张等,2025;龚等,2025;高等,2025;代理RL;)列车. 大语言模型(LLM)代理商(姚等,2022;申等,2023)通过在线推出和奖励反馈,实现多回合推理,工具使用,与外部环境互动,产生广泛的性能收益. 最近,LLM代理商已经吸收了先进的推论技术,如上下文管理(Mei等,2025;Zhang等,2026a)和取用工程(周等,2026;Lin等,2026)等,使代理工作流程能够应对日益复杂和漫长的任务. 然而,大多数代理式RL方法都采用单会场设置,每次推出都是在不断积累的背景下作为一个连贯的多转轨迹展开,并产生一个单一的培训段(Wang等,2026;Xu等,2026b.).

blocks.en: We argue that the single-session setting is not sufficiently general for optimizing LLM agents. For example, context compaction compresses the execution history to free up context space while rewriting the prefix that conditions subsequent actions ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) , thereby initiating a new session. Similarly, subagent forking delegates global goal to subagents which creates branch sessions ( Xu et al., 2026d ; Team et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2025 ) . Those resulting trajectories no longer satisfy the single-session assumption, creating a mismatch between training and inference that compromises consistency and limits optimization potential.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,单会场设置不足以优化LLM代理。 例如,上下文收缩压缩了执行历史,以腾出上下文空间,同时重写为后续行动创造条件的前缀(Nguyen等,2025;Wu等,2025;Lu等,2025),从而启动了新的会话. 同样,副代理人将全球目标分配给创建分支会议的副代理人(徐等,2026d;Team等,2026;Song等,2025)。 由此产生的轨迹不再能满足单会场假设,造成培训与推论不相匹配,损害了一致性并限制了优化潜力.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce a new setting termed Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning , which supports an arbitrary count of sessions and enables agents with diverse inference mechanisms to be optimized within a unified algorithm. A straightforward way to handle multi-session rollouts is through broadcasting , whereby a trajectory-level outcome reward or advantage is replicated to every token across all sessions ( Accio-Lab, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . However, we argue that this method provides only coarse supervision and offers no explicit control over optimization across sessions, resulting in poorly targeted learning signals as trajectories span more sessions.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了一种称为多会代理强化学习的新设置,它支持任意计数会话,并使具有不同推论机制的代理在统一的算法内得到优化。 处理多场会议推出的一个直截了当的方法是通过广播,通过广播,在所有会议中将轨迹级结果的奖励或优势推广到每个标志(Accio-Lab, 2026;Xu等人, 2026a)。 然而,我们争辩说,这种方法只提供粗糙的监督,没有对各届的优化提供明确的控制,导致学习信号针对性差,因为轨迹跨越更多的会话。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose Mosaic , a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. First, session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation calibrates outcome-based advantages using within-group rankings of session counts conditioned on task outcomes, encouraging successful trajectories to solve tasks efficiently while allowing unsuccessful trajectories sufficient exploration. Its bounded modulation preserves outcome-induced ordering while incorporating session-usage guidance, thereby widening relative advantage margins for homogeneous-reward groups. Second, session-level advantage shaping calculates each session’s marginal outcome gain as an immediate reward, applies group-relative normalization separately by session type, and combines the resulting shaping signal with the trajectory-level advantage. Overall, the former provides a long-term, outcome-oriented global signal, while the latter captures short-term local marginal effects. They together form a hierarchical optimization target for multi-session agentic RL.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出Mosaic 是一种多会场的代理RL方法,具有无评论的等级优化. 首先,认识到会话轨迹的优势估计利用以任务结果为条件的分组内排序来校正基于结果的优势,鼓励成功的轨迹高效地解决任务,同时允许不成功的轨迹充分探索。 其有限度的调制保留了结果引起的命令,同时纳入了会议使用指导,从而扩大了对同等报酬群体的相对优势幅度。 第二,会话级优势塑造计算出每场会话的边际结果收益作为即时奖励,按会话类型分别适用群体相适应性规范化,并结合由此产生的会话信号和轨迹级优势. 总体而言,前者提供了一个面向成果的长期全球信号,而后者则捕捉到当地短期的边缘效应. 它们共同构成了多会场代理RL的分级优化目标.

blocks.en: To evaluate our method, we conduct experiments on BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and select Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the base model. Our Mosaic outperforms multiple single-session and multi-session agentic RL baselines under both context compaction and subagent forking scenarios. Moreover, Mosaic achieves up to a 10.1% relative improvement in accuracy over the broadcasting baseline while using fewer sessions per trajectory on average ( 3.17 → 2.35 3.17\rightarrow 2.35 ). Ablation studies further demonstrate that session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation and session-level advantage shaping each contribute to the final performance gains. Our analyses also reveal several key insights: (1) shaping trajectory-level advantages with session counts increases within-group advantage variance and improves sample efficiency; (2) different session types exhibit distinct distributions of session-level marginal gains, which our type-conditioned normalization helps stabilize; (3) effective multi-session optimization improves session utility and allocation, a pattern that Mosaic strengthens and that might offer a potential direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 为了评价我们的方法,我们进行了BrowsComp(Wei等,2025年)的实验,并选择了Quen3.5-4B(Quen Team,2026年)作为基准模型. 我们的Mosaic在上下文收缩和下下文试剂两种情景下,都超过了多个单会场和多会场代理RL基线。 此外,Mosaic的准确度比广播基准提高10.1%,而平均每个轨迹使用次数较少(3.17 – 2.35 3.17平方英寸35)。 分析研究进一步表明,对会议轨迹水平的优势估计和会议水平的优势决定了每个人的最终业绩收益。 我们的分析还揭示出若干关键见解:(1) 塑造轨迹层面的优势,以会议计数增加集团内部的优势差异并改进抽样效率;(2) 不同会场类型显示出会议层面边际收益的不同分布,我们类型的正常化有助于稳定会议场面;(3) 有效的多会场优化改进了会议效用和分配,这种模式是Mosaic加强的,可能为今后的工作提供潜在方向。

blocks.en: This formulation yields a single token-weighted trajectory-level objective for each rollout, regardless of its session count, thereby preserving equal weighting across rollouts within a prompt group and stabilizing training-signal scales across tokens. However, broadcasting offers only coarse supervision and no explicit control over optimization across sessions, causing poorly targeted learning signals as trajectories span more sessions. To address this limitation, we propose Mosaic , which improves multi-session agentic RL through session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation and session-level advantage shaping.

blocks.en: In Mosaic , we optimize the performance of multi-session agentic RL through a hierarchical perspective, incorporating trajectory-level advantage estimation calibrated with session signals (§ 3.1 ), as well as advantage shaping at the finer-grained session level. (§ 3.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Session-Aware Advantage Estimation
blocks.zh: 3.1 会话评估

blocks.en: In vanilla GRPO, the advantage is determined solely by the relative outcome rewards within a prompt group. Under the multi-session setting, however, session-related metrics may provide additional relative signals for policy optimization. One metric is the number of sessions N i N_{i} in a trajectory τ i \tau_{i} , which serves as a proxy for the extent of exploration and structural complexity of τ i \tau_{i} . Nonetheless, N i N_{i} should not be directly treated as a reward. First, its raw scale may not faithfully quantify meaningful differences in session utilization. Second, the preferred direction of optimization should depend on task results, avoiding the policy from exploiting session count without improving performance.
blocks.zh: 在"香草GRPO"中,优势完全取决于一个即时组内的相对结果奖励. 然而,在多会情况下,与会议有关的衡量尺度可为政策优化提供更多的相对信号。 一个衡量标准是轨迹中的会话次数(N i N_{i})\i tau_{i},它充当了\i tau_{i}探索范围和结构复杂性的代名词. 然而,N i N_{i}不应被直接视为奖励。 第一,其原始规模可能无法忠实地量化会议利用方面的有意义的差异。 第二,优化的首选方向应取决于任务结果,避免政策在不改进业绩的情况下利用会议次数。

blocks.en: Accordingly, from a group-relative perspective, the session-aware trajectory-level advantages of multi-session rollouts within a prompt group should satisfy the following ordering constraints: • C1 : For successful trajectories, using more sessions incurs a higher execution cost and hence results in a lower advantage, whereas using fewer sessions should result in a higher advantage. • C2 : For unsuccessful trajectories, using fewer sessions may suggest insufficient exploration or execution, especially on challenging tasks, and should thus result in a lower advantage. Conversely, unsuccessful trajectories that conduct more sessions should receive a higher advantage. • C3 : Task outcome reward must remain the dominant signal. When two trajectories have the same session counts, the trajectory with lower reward should receive a lower advantage. Using more sessions alone should not allow an unsuccessful trajectory to outrank a successful one.

blocks.en: 3.2 Session-Level Advantage Shaping
blocks.zh: 3.2 会话级优势

blocks.en: The session-aware trajectory-level advantage developed in § 3.1 provides an outcome-oriented global optimization signal for the entire multi-session trajectory. At the session level, however, this signal remains sparse since all sessions on the same trajectory share a single scalar advantage. To this end, we introduce session-level advantage shaping. Specifically, we view each session as a state transition as s i , j = ( v i , j − 1 → v i , j ) s_{i,j}=\left(v_{i,j-1}\rightarrow v_{i,j}\right) , where session s i , j s_{i,j} transitions the agent from state v i , j − 1 v_{i,j-1} to state v i , j v_{i,j} . Here, v i , j − 1 v_{i,j-1} and v i , j v_{i,j} denote the agent states at the start and end of the j j -th session, respectively, with particular emphasis on the prefix context visible to the rollout policy. Based on session transition functions, we introduce three representative session types: • Normal session . The agent performs regular reasoning, tool use, and environment interaction within the current context. The input state is the context available at the start of the session, and its output state is the resulting context after the session is completed. • Compaction session . When the accumulated context approaches the model’s limit, the agent starts a compaction session to compress the context into a shorter prefix. Its input state is the full context before compaction, and its output state is the compressed prefix passed to the next session. • Subagent session . The main agent delegates subtasks to subagents which start new subagent sessions. Its input state is the main-agent context at delegation, and its output state is the updated main-agent context after the returned result has been incorporated.

blocks.en: Compaction session . When the accumulated context approaches the model’s limit, the agent starts a compaction session to compress the context into a shorter prefix. Its input state is the full context before compaction, and its output state is the compressed prefix passed to the next session.

blocks.en: Subagent session . The main agent delegates subtasks to subagents which start new subagent sessions. Its input state is the main-agent context at delegation, and its output state is the updated main-agent context after the returned result has been incorporated.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , a challenging benchmark consisting of 1,266 questions that require agents to persistently navigate the web and identify hard-to-find, entangled information. We select BrowseComp since its high difficulty demands long-horizon interactions, making it suitable for assessing agents that produce multi-session trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了我们关于浏览器Comp(Wei等人,2025年)的方法,这是一个具有挑战性的基准,由1 266个问题组成,要求特工持续浏览网络并找出难以找到、缠绕的信息。 我们选择浏览器COMP,因为它的高度困难需要长视距相互作用,因此适合评估产生多会轨迹的剂.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the initial model and adopt a ReAct-style agent loop. We organize the baselines by inference configuration. Under single-session inference , we evaluate (1) the initial model without RL training and (2) a model trained with GRPO in the single-session setting, representing conventional Agentic RL. Under multi-session inference , we evaluate (3) the single-session GRPO trained model, representing test-time scaling; (4) a model trained with Broadcasting in the multi-session setting; and (5) a model trained with Mosaic in the multi-session setting. We evaluate all multi-session configurations under both context compaction and subagent forking using their respective agent loops; for multi-session training, the same loops are used to collect rollouts. Finally, since our session-level advantage shaping in § 3.2 builds on information gain, we evaluate (6) a single-session model trained with IGPO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用Quen3.5-4B(Quen Team,2026)作为初始型号,并采用ReAct风格的代理循环. 我们通过推论配置来组织基线. 在单会场推论下,我们评价 (1) 初步模型,不经过RL培训; (2) 在单会场设置中经过GRPO培训的模型,代表了传统的Agentic RL. 根据多会的推论,我们评价(3) 单会的GRPO培训模式,代表测试时间的缩放;(4) 多会的广播培训模式;(5) 多会的Mosaic培训模式。 我们评价上下文收缩下的所有多会场配置,并使用各自的代理圈来进行副剂活化;对于多会场培训,使用相同的循环来收集推广. 最后,由于我们在第3.2节中形成的会场优势建立在信息收益的基础上,我们评估了(6)与IGPO一起培训的会场模式(Wang等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 4.2 RQ1: Overall Effectiveness of Mosaic
blocks.zh: 4.2 RQ1: Mosaic的整体有效性

blocks.en: RQ1 asks whether training in the multi-session setting improves agent performance and whether Mosaic contributes beyond broadcasting .
blocks.zh: RQ1询问多会培训是否提高代理业绩,

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , single-session inference has limited effectiveness on BrowseComp. Agentic RL training in the single-session setting yields modest gains, even when combined with test-time scaling in the multi-session setting. This suggests that multi-session inference capabilities do not readily emerge through generalization alone. Among methods trained on multi-session trajectories, Broadcasting improves multi-session inference performance. Mosaic improves it further, outperforming all baselines in both the compact and subagent scenarios. Figure 3 (a) illustrates the transformative gains from multi-session inference, multi-session training, and Mosaic .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,单会话推断对浏览孔通公司的效力有限。 单会场环境下的代理式RL培训,即使与多会场环境下的测试时间缩放相结合,也获得微小收益. 这表明,单靠一般化并不能很容易地产生多会场的推论能力. 在多会轨迹培训的方法中,广播改进了多会推理的表现. Mosaic进一步改进了它,在紧凑的和亚剂的情景中都比所有基线都好。 图3(a)显示多会推论、多会培训和Mosaic带来的变革成果。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the training dynamics of each method. Mosaic boosts trajectory reward faster than Broadcasting and reaches a higher level. The number of sessions increases over training for both methods, but its growth levels off more clearly with Mosaic . This may be partly due to the more targeted signal provided by its session-aware advantage, which discourages unnecessary increases in session count. Overall, Mosaic achieves better task performance at lower execution cost.
blocks.zh: 图4显示每种方法的培训动态。 Mosaic提升了轨道奖励的速度比广播快,并达到了更高的水平. 课程数量比两种方法的培训都增加,但其增长水平与Mosaic相比更为明显。 其部分原因可能是其会议感知优势提供了更有针对性的信号,不利于不必要的增加会议次数。 总体而言,Mosaic以更低的执行成本实现更好的任务性能.

blocks.en: As § 3.2 applies marginal gain to session-level advantage shaping, we thus compare Mosaic with IGPO, which applies it at the turn level. From Table 1 , Mosaic achieves better performance than IGPO. Moreover, Figure 3 (b) shows that Mosaic substantially reduces the wall-time of computing marginal gains, enhancing performance while cutting computational cost.
blocks.zh: 由于§3.2将边际收益应用于会话级优势的塑造,因此我们比较了Mosaic和IGPO,后者在转会级应用. 从表格 1,Mosaic取得优于IGPO的性能. 此外,图3(b)显示,Mosaic大大缩短了计算边际收益的墙壁时间,提高了性能,同时降低了计算成本.

blocks.en: 4.3 RQ2: Ablation Study of Mosaic
blocks.zh: 4.3 RQ2: Mosaic的读取研究

blocks.en: RQ2 asks whether each component of Mosaic contributes to its overall performance .
blocks.zh: RQ2询问Mosaic的每个组成部分是否都为总体业绩做出贡献.

blocks.en: Figure 3 (c)(d) presents the ablation results. Relative to Broadcasting, both levels of components in Mosaic , namely trajectory-level session-aware advantage estimation and session-level advantage shaping, contribute to the enhanced final performance. Combining the two components yields a clear additional gain in the compact scenario, but only a modest gain in the subagent scenario. One possible explanation lies in their session structures: compact trajectories are linear, whereas subagent trajectories have a nonlinear structure that more closely resembles a directed acyclic graph. In the latter case, a session may influence multiple succeeding sessions. Its immediate reward, estimated from marginal gain, may thus differ from its actual contribution to the final outcome.
blocks.zh: 图3(c)(d)列出膨胀结果。 相对于广播,Mosaic的两层组件,即轨迹级会话优势估计和会话级优势塑造,都有助于提升最终性能. 将这两个部分合并在一起,在紧凑的情景中会产生明显的额外收益,但在亚物剂情景中只产生微小收益. 一个可能的解释在于它们的会话结构:紧凑的轨迹是线性的,而亚剂轨迹则有一个更接近于定向环形图的非线性结构. 在后一种情况下,一届会议可能影响以后的多届会议。 因此,根据边际收益估计,其直接报酬可能不同于其对最终结果的实际贡献。

blocks.en: 4.4 RQ3: Mechanistic Analysis of Mosaic
blocks.zh: 4.4 RQ3: Mosaic的机械分析

blocks.en: RQ3 asks how the design of Mosaic contributes to the training process .
blocks.zh: RQ3询问Mosaic的设计如何促进培训过程。

blocks.en: First, we examine whether session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation produces the intended ordering. As shown in Figure 5 , within mixed-outcome groups, advantages approximately decrease with session count for successful trajectories and increase for unsuccessful ones, while successful trajectories retain higher advantages. In homogeneous-outcome groups, the fallback mechanism introduces session-dependent variation, providing differentiated learning signals despite identical outcome rewards. These patterns illustrate how Mosaic leverages session signals to increase the within-group variance of relative advantages, thus improving sample efficiency during training.
blocks.zh: 第一,我们审查是否认识到会话轨迹水平优势估计得出预定命令。 如图5所显示的,在混合结果组中,成功轨迹的场次计算和失败轨迹的增加,其优点大约会减少,而成功轨迹保留了较高的优点。 在相同结果组中,倒置机制引入了依赖会话的变异,提供不同的学习信号,尽管结果回报相同。 这些模式说明了Mosaic如何利用会话信号来增加群体内相对优势的差异,从而在培训期间提高样本效率.

blocks.en: Second, we examine the effect of reward normalization on session-level shaping signals. As shown in Figure 5 , the distributions of raw marginal information gain differ across session types, primarily because heterogeneous sessions serve distinct functions. Under global normalization, compaction sessions, whose raw marginal gains have a lower mean, are further downweighted, introducing a systematic bias against them. In Mosaic , type-conditioned normalization instead centers and rescales each type separately, enabling both types to receive positive and negative signals relative to their respective baselines. This reduces type-dependent distributional bias in advantage shaping.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们审查奖励正常化对会议一级塑造信号的影响。 如图5所示,原始边际信息收益的分配因会议类型不同而不同,主要原因是会议内容不同,功能不同。 在全球正常化下,紧凑会议 -- -- 其原始微薄收益的平分较低 -- -- 被进一步压低了体重,对会议造成系统性偏见。 在Mosaic语中,有类型条件的正常化取而代之,将每种类型分别调整,使两种类型都能收到与各自基线相对的正负信号。 这减少了在优势塑造中依赖型的分布偏差.

blocks.en: 4.5 RQ4: Understanding Multi-Session Optimization
blocks.zh: 4.5 RQ4:理解多会优化

blocks.en: Multi-session optimization introduces an additional degree of freedom in how computation is distributed across sessions. However, the session count used by Mosaic serves only as a proxy signal and is not inherently tied to exploration intensity or execution cost. Moreover, at inference time, the model has no access to hindsight: it does not know how many sessions a trajectory will ultimately contain or whether the trajectory will succeed. Therefore, RQ4 moves beyond method-specific analysis and asks a broader question: when multi-session optimization improves task performance, what session-level behavioral patterns emerge?
blocks.zh: 多会场优化在会议间如何分配计算方面引入了额外的自由度. 然而,Mosaic使用的会话计数只是一种代用信号,与勘探强度或执行成本并无内在联系. 此外,在推论时间,模型无法访问后视:它不知道一个轨迹最终会包含多少会话,或者轨迹是否成功. 因此,RQ4超越了方法特定分析,并提出了一个更广泛的问题:当多会场优化改善任务性能时,会场一级的行为模式会出现什么?

blocks.en: Accordingly, we examine session-level behavior along three dimensions: quantity , or whether the count of sessions increases or decreases; quality , or whether performance improvement is accompanied by more useful sessions; and allocation , or whether a limited session budget becomes increasingly concentrated on execution stages with high marginal utility. As shown in Table 2 , for Broadcasting, which does not directly optimize any specific session-aware pattern, all three metrics increase. Under Mosaic , the number of sessions does not increase further, while both session quality and allocation improve. These findings indicate that performance gains via multi-session optimization are associated with improved session utility rather than a monotonic rise in session count. Moreover, despite using explicit session-aware optimization, Mosaic does not induce a fundamentally altered behavioral mechanism. Instead, it strengthens the session-allocation patterns that already emerge from naïve multi-session optimization.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们从三个方面审查会议一级的行为:数量,或会议次数增加或减少;质量,或业绩改进是否伴有更有用的会议;分配,或有限会议预算是否越来越集中于效用不大的执行阶段。 如表2所示,对于没有直接优化任何特定会话感知模式的广播,所有这三种度量都增加了. 在Mosaic 下,届会次数没有进一步增加,而会议质量和分配都有所改善。 这些调查结果表明,通过多会场优化提高绩效与会议效用的改进有关,而不是单调增加会议次数。 此外,尽管使用明确的会话意识优化,Mosaic并没有诱发一种根本改变的行为机制. 相反,它加强了从天真多会优化中已经出现的会议分配模式。

blocks.en: We argue that effective multi-session optimization is accompanied by improvements in session utility and allocation. It distributes computation more effectively across sessions, encouraging continued execution when it yields meaningful progress while suppressing low-utility computation. From this perspective, the central challenge is not how many sessions an agent should use, but how much useful progress it can derive from the sessions it executes.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,有效的多会优化的同时,会议效用和分配也有所改善。 它更有效地在各会期内分发计算,鼓励在取得有意义的进展时继续执行,同时抑制低效用计算。 从这个角度看,中心的挑战不是代理人应使用多少会话,而是它所执行的会话能产生多少有益的进展。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion: Future Directions for Multi-Session Agentic RL
blocks.zh: 5 讨论:多会期代理规则的未来方向

blocks.en: Multi-session trajectories tend to arise naturally when agents tackle complex, long-horizon tasks. Although some existing benchmarks can elicit these trajectories with reasonable frequency, suitable public training data remain scarce. This gap limits the scale, sufficiency, and reproducibility of experiments in multi-session agentic RL. Developing open training datasets and corresponding agentic execution environments is therefore essential to building a sustainable research ecosystem for this topic.
blocks.zh: 多会场轨迹往往在特工处理复杂而长距离的任务时自然而然地出现. 虽然现有的一些基准能够以合理的频率得出这些轨迹,但适当的公共培训数据仍然很少。 这种差距限制了多会场剂RL中实验的规模,充足性和可再生性. 因此,开发开放式培训数据集和相应的代理执行环境,对于为这一专题建立可持续的研究生态系统至关重要。

blocks.en: Context compaction and subagent forking both involve information transfer, but serve different purposes: compaction must preserve sufficient working state for continued execution; forking must provide the information needed to complete a subtask; merging must integrate subtask results into a state usable by the main agent. These operations motivate a shared research question: under a limited context budget, what information should be carried forward to support subsequent decisions? CompactionRL already jointly optimizes task execution and context summarization ( Li et al., 2026 ) . A unified approach to learning state transfer across compaction, forking, and merging remains an important direction, alongside systematic investigation of information loss and error accumulation over repeated transfers.
blocks.zh: 上下文收缩和下下文试剂活化都涉及信息传输,但服务于不同目的:收缩必须保持足够的工作状态以继续被执行;活化必须提供完成子任务所需的信息;合并必须将子任务结果整合到一个主要代理可以使用的状态. 这些行动引发了一个共同的研究问题:在有限的预算范围内,应该提供哪些信息来支持随后的决定? 压缩 RL已经联合优化了任务执行和上下文概括(Li等,2026. 在系统调查信息丢失和重复转让的误差积累的同时,对跨越收缩、铸造和合并的学习状态转移采取统一办法仍然是一个重要的方向。

blocks.en: For partial rollout or asynchronous training settings, multi-session execution can amplify variation in trajectory lengths and completion times, increase policy staleness and complicate within-group comparisons and sample reuse. For instance, prioritizing completed rollouts may favor trajectories with less sessions over longer ones associated with harder tasks, introducing selection bias and shaping learned execution strategies. Our experiments use a colocated setup with alternating rollout and training phases to minimize interference from asynchrony and isolate the effects of the optimization signals. Scaling toward actual production raises a further question: how can multi-session optimization remain reliable under asynchronous sampling and policy staleness? SAO explores asynchronous optimization with one rollout per prompt, using a learned value model ( Hou et al., 2026 ) . However, critic-free, group-relative optimization requires further investigation into when and how rollout groups are formed, how stale samples are handled, and how collected trajectories can be reused.
blocks.zh: 就部分推出或同步培训环境而言,多会执行可扩大轨迹长度和完成时间的变化,增加政策停滞性,使组内比较和样本再利用复杂化。 例如,优先安排已完成的推出工作,可能有利于会议次数较少的轨迹,而不是与较困难的任务有关的较长轨迹,引入选择偏好,并制订学习到的执行战略。 我们的实验使用一个位于同一位置的装置,并交替展开和培训阶段,以尽量减少同步干扰,并隔离优化信号的影响。 向实际生产规模的扩大提出了另一个问题:在同步取样和政策僵化的情况下,多场优化如何保持可靠? SAO探索同步优化,每快推出一款,采用已学习到的价值模型(Hou等,2026年). 然而,无评论,同群相通的优化需要进一步研究何时和如何形成"推出"组,如何处理被分解的样品,以及如何再利用所收集的轨迹.

blocks.en: General multi-session agentic RL can accommodate workflows in which execution no longer follows a single, continuously accumulated context prefix. Context compaction and subagent forking, the two scenarios studied in this work, are representative examples of such workflows in modern agent harnesses. Progress in multi-session optimization could thus provide an important foundation for training agents within harnesses whose orchestration is partially opaque ( Xu et al., 2026a ) , such as Claude Code. Therefore, a critical next step is to systematically examine mechanisms across agent harnesses that disrupt context continuity, such as dropping reasoning tokens or tool responses, and improve general multi-session agentic RL under these conditions. Additionally, when discontinuity occurs, the choice between introducing a new session boundary and applying lossy concatenation with the preceding session may also influence the overall effectiveness of optimization.
blocks.zh: 一般多会场代理RL可以容纳执行中不再遵循单一,连续累积上下文前缀的工作流程. 本文所研究的两种情景,即上下文收缩和下底物活化,是现代物剂拉带中这种工作流程的典型例子。 因此,在多会优化方面取得的进展可以为培训部分不透明(徐等,2026a)的领带内的人员提供重要基础,例如克洛德守则。 因此,下一个关键步骤是系统地审查干扰环境连续性的跨代理机制,如降下推理符或工具反应,并在这些条件下改进一般多会场代理RL。 此外,当出现不连续时,在引入新的会话界限和采用与上会话相错的结合方式之间作出选择,也可能影响优化的总体效果。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: LLM agents extend LLMs with tool use and environment interaction to work autonomously ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . ReAct constructs a general agent loop of reasoning, acting, observing environment feedback, and continuing until task completion ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . To handle complex and long-horizon tasks, recent systems develop agent harnesses that manage execution beyond the basic ReAct loop ( Works, 2026 ; OpenClaw, 2026 ) , incorporating context compaction ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ) , multi-agent system ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , subagent forking ( Team et al., 2026 ) , and other forms of context and workflow management ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM剂将LLMs与工具使用和环境相互作用相扩展,使其自主工作(Feng等,2026;Li等,2025;Wu等,2026;Wang等,2024)。 ReAct构建了推理,演绎,观察环境反馈的一般代理循环,并持续到任务完成(姚等,2022.). 为了处理复杂而漫长的任务,最近的系统开发了管理超出基本ReAct循环的行刑的代理手段(Works,2026;OpenClaw,2026),包括上下文收缩(Nguyen等人,2025),多代理手段系统(Chen等人,2026a),副代理伪造(Team等人,2026),以及其他形式的上下文和工作流程管理(Shi等人,2026;Xu等人,2026c;Zhang等人,2026a;Chen等人,2025;Kim等人,2025;Yang等人,2026)。

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning techniques such as RLHF ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) and RLVR ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2026 ) are used to improve LLMs’ alignment, reasoning, and downstream task-solving capabilities ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) . Agentic RL extends this paradigm to LLM agents, aiming to enhance capabilities of multi-turn interaction through enhanced rollout sampling ( Dong et al., 2026 ; Hou et al., 2025 ) , process-level reward design ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , and other optimization strategies ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . However, most existing agentic RL methods still assume that each trajectory is contained within a single session.
blocks.zh: 强化学习技术如RLHF(欧阳等,2022;张等,2026b)和RLVR(陈等,2026b;于等,2026)用于提高LLMs的相接,推理,下游任务解决能力(郑等,2025;谭等,2025.). 代理RL将这一范式延伸至LLM剂上,旨在通过强化推出采样(Dong等,2026;Hou等,2025),工艺级奖励设计(Zhang等,2026c;Liu等,2026),以及其他优化策略(Deng等,2026)来增强多回合互动能力. 然而,大多数现有的代理RL方法仍然假设每个轨迹都包含在一个会话中.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we first identify a mismatch between the single-session assumption underlying most existing agentic RL methods and advanced agentic inference techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking. This motivates our formulation of Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, which supports an arbitrary count of sessions within a trajectory. To address the coarse supervision issue existed in the currently widely used broadcasting approach, we further propose Mosaic , a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. By combining session-aware trajectory-level advantage estimation with session-level advantage shaping, Mosaic trains a Qwen3.5-4B agent that outperforms both single-session and multi-session baselines on BrowseComp. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component, while further analyses suggest that effective multi-session optimization might depend on improving session utility and allocation, a pattern observed in both broadcasting baseline and our Mosaic . We hope these findings will inform future research on multi-session agentic RL.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们首先指出,大多数现有代理RL方法所基于的单会话假设与上下文收缩和分试剂活化等先进代理推论技术不匹配. 这促使我们制定 " 多会代理强化学习 " ,支持在轨迹中任意计数会议。 为了解决目前广泛使用的广播方式中存在的粗放监督问题,我们进一步建议Mosaic,一种多会场代理RL方法,无评论的分级优化. Mosaic通过将会话-认知轨迹级优势估计与会话级优势的形成相结合,在浏览孔通上训练出一个表现优于单会话和多会话基线的Quen3.5-4B代理. 篇幅研究证实了每个组成部分的贡献,而进一步的分析表明,有效的多会优化可能取决于会议效用和分配的改善,广播基线和我们的Mosaic都观察到这种模式。 我们希望这些结论将为今后关于多会性RL的研究提供参考.

blocks.en: Our session-aware trajectory-level advantage in § 3.1 combines an outcome-based advantage with signal about session usage. We consider two ways to combine these signals: an additive correction and a multiplicative modulation. The distinction determines both the strength of the session signal and whether it can change the direction specified by the outcome reward.
blocks.zh: 我们第3.1节中的会话认知轨迹级优势结合了基于结果的优势和关于会话使用量的信号. 我们考虑将这两种信号结合起来的方法:一种是添加式校正,另一种是多相调制. 区分既决定了会话信号的强度,也决定了它是否能够改变结果奖励所指定的方向.

It can therefore produce a nonzero learning signal even when all trajectories in a prompt group receive the same outcome reward and A ^ i traj = 0 \hat{A}_{i}^{\mathrm{traj}}=0 . However, the relative meaning of the two terms is difficult to calibrate. Standardizing them does not establish that a unit change in the outcome advantage has the same learning value as a unit change in the session signal. Therefore, a sufficiently strong session signal can dominate the outcome-based objective.

blocks.en: C.1 Rollout in Context Compaction
blocks.zh: C.1 在背景压缩中推出

blocks.en: This section specifies the context compaction scenario used for the multi-session setting. The inference retains the standard ReAct interaction protocol, but converts a long execution into a sequence of sessions whenever the current working context can no longer safely accommodate another agent turn. All sessions are generated by the same policy. In the on-policy configuration used in our experiments, the compaction summary is also generated by the policy and is therefore optimized as a separate training segment.
blocks.zh: 本节具体说明用于多会场设置的上下文收缩情景. 推论保留了标准ReAct交互协议,但当当前工作环境无法安全地容纳另一个代理转会时,会将长执行转换为会话序列. 所有会议都是由同一政策产生的。 在我们实验中使用的政策配置中,紧凑摘要也是由政策产生的,因此被优化为一个单独的培训部分.

blocks.en: Each rollout begins with a standard agentic search session. The policy model receives the following system instruction, together with the original user question and the native function schemas for two tools, search and visit . The schemas are provided through the model’s chat template. The agent may invoke at most one tool in each turn.

blocks.en: Base System Prompt You are a deep research assistant. Your core function is to conduct thorough, multi-source investigations into any topic. You must handle both broad, open-domain inquiries and queries within specialized academic fields. For each user request, you must actively seek out and **cross-check information** from credible and diverse sources, then integrate the findings into a response that is comprehensive, accurate, well-structured, and objective. When you have gathered sufficient information and are ready to provide the definitive response, you must enclose the entire final answer in <answer></answer> tags. You may call one function at a time to assist with the user query. Current date: {date} . {query}

blocks.en: At turn t t , the agent produces either a final answer or one tool call. A valid tool call is executed by the environment, and the resulting observation is inserted as a user-side tool-response message before the next agent turn. Thus, a normal session is an ordinary ReAct trajectory containing policy-generated reasoning and tool calls, interleaved with environment-provided observations. Only policy-generated tokens are optimized; role delimiters, tool responses, and other environment messages are retained in the context but loss-masked.
blocks.zh: 在t t 转弯时,代理生成一个最终答案或一个工具呼叫. 有效的工具调用由环境执行,由此产生的观察结果被插入到下一个代理调用前作为用户端的工具响应消息. 因此,正常的会话是一个普通的ReAct轨迹,包含由政策产生的推理和工具调用,与环境提供的观测结果互通. 只有由政策产生的符号才得到优化;在上下文中保留了角色划分符、工具响应和其他环境信息,但有损失。

blocks.en: Let L ′ L^{\prime} denote the maximum context length of one session and let B B denote a reserved generation budget. In our experiments, L ′ = 131,072 L^{\prime}=131{,}072 and B = 16,384 B=16{,}384 tokens. Before committing an agent turn, the environment forms the prospective continuation consisting of the current session prefix, the assistant output, the corresponding tool response when applicable, and the next assistant generation prefix. If its length exceeds L ′ − B L^{\prime}-B , the prospective turn is discarded: neither its generated tokens nor its observation becomes part of the retained trajectory. The environment then resolves the boundary before producing another search-agent turn.
blocks.zh: 让L ' L^{\prime]表示一届会议的最大上下文长度,让B表示预留的生成预算。 在我们的实验中,L ' =131,072 L^{\prime * 131{,}072 and B =16,384 B = 16{,}384个令牌. 在进行代理转接之前,环境构成预期的续接,包括当前会话前缀,助手输出,在适用时相应的工具响应,以及下一个助手生成前缀. 如果长度超过L '-B L^{\prime}-B,则未来转弯被丢弃:其生成的活字符号和观察都没有成为所保留轨迹的一部分. 然后环境在产生另一个搜索代理转弯之前解决了边界.

blocks.en: When the rollout has not reached its compaction budget, the boundary triggers context compaction. We allow at most ten successful compactions per rollout. If the summary cannot be parsed, or if the compaction budget has already been exhausted, the environment instead asks the current session to terminate with a final answer:
blocks.zh: 当推出未达到收缩预算时,边界会触发上下文收缩. 我们每次推出最多允许10个成功的收缩。 如果摘要无法解析,或者压缩预算已经用尽,环境要求本届会议以最后答案结束:

blocks.en: Forced-answer Message You have reached the maximum context length. Based on the information and knowledge you have gathered, please provide the entire final answer in <answer></answer> tags now.
blocks.zh: 强制回答消息 您已达到最大上下文长度 。 根据你所收集的信息和知识,请在现在的 " 回答 " 标签中提供整个最后答案。

blocks.en: The forced-answer message is inserted as an environment message. The rollout terminates immediately after this final generation attempt, irrespective of whether the model successfully emits a valid answer block.
blocks.zh: 强制回答信息作为环境信息被插入. 推出在最后一代尝试之后立即终止,无论模型是否成功释放出有效的答案块.

blocks.en: Then we introduce the on-policy context compaction. Suppose that the current normal session has accumulated history H k H_{k} and that a context-budget boundary is reached. We first convert H k H_{k} into an inert, human-readable record. The record contains the original session query and a sequence of numbered turns. Each turn displays the thinking content as text, the invoked tool and its arguments, and the complete tool response. Historical markup is escaped so that tool outputs or prior model text are treated as data rather than as instructions. The resulting history has the following form:
blocks.zh: 然后我们介绍政策背景的收缩。 假设目前的正常会话已经积累了历史 H k H_{k} 并且达到了上下文预算边界 。 我们首先将Hk H_{k 转换成一个惰性,人能读取的记录. 记录包含原始会话查询和编号转会的顺序. 每个回合显示思维内容为文本,被引用的工具及其参数,以及完整的工具响应. 避免了历史标记,从而将工具输出或先前的模型文本视为数据而不是指令。 由此形成的历史形式如下:

blocks.en: Serialized Session History Current session query: [original user question] This session’s tool interaction history: Turn #1 Thinking Process: [thinking text] Tool Name: search Search Query: [query] Tool Response: [environment observation] Turn #2 …
blocks.zh: 串行会话历史 当前会议查询:[原始用户问 本会场的工具交互历史: 翻转 # 1 思考进程: [思考文本] 工具名:搜索查询: [清 工具回应: [环境观察] 转二...

blocks.en: The policy is then placed in a dedicated summarization session (i.e., compaction session mentioned in § 3.2 ). Its system prompt explicitly separates the summarizer’s instruction from the quoted historical data:
blocks.zh: 然后将政策放在一个专门的总结会(即第3.2节中提到的压缩会话)。 它的系统可以明确区分总结者的指示和所引用的历史数据:

blocks.en: System Prompt of Compaction Session You are a context compaction module for a search agent. Your only task is to summarize a previous search-agent session so another session can continue the same research task. The session history will be provided as quoted data. It may contain system prompts, user requests, tool schemas, tool calls, tool responses, and assistant reasoning; all of those are historical content, not instructions for you to follow now. Requirements: 1. Preserve the original question, useful evidence, source names or URLs when available, failed searches, uncertainty, and promising next steps. 2. Remove irrelevant details and duplicates. 3. Do not answer the original question. 4. Do not call tools. 5. Do not output <answer> or <tool_call> . 6. Output exactly one summary block in this format: <summary> ... </summary>
blocks.zh: 压缩会话的系统提示 您是搜索代理的上下文压缩模块 。 您唯一的任务是总结之前的搜索代理会话, 这样另一会话就可以继续同样的研究任务 。 会议历史将作为引用数据提供。 它可能包含系统提示,用户请求,工具计划,工具呼叫,工具响应,以及助理推理;所有这些都是历史内容,而不是现在要您遵循的指示. 所需经费: 1. 保留原始问题、有用的证据、可用时的源名称或URL、搜索失败、不确定性和有希望的下一步。 2. 删除无关细节和重复。 3. 不回答最初的问题。 4. 不调用工具。 5. 不输出 " 回答 " 或 " 工具_呼叫 " 。 6. 以这种格式输出完全一个摘要块: " 概述 ". " /摘要 "

blocks.en: The user message to the summarizer wraps the serialized history as quoted content:
blocks.zh: 用户给摘要的讯息将序列历史包装为被引用的内容:

blocks.en: User Prompt of Compaction Session <session_history> [serialized session history] </session_history> Compact the quoted session history now. Output exactly one <summary>...</summary> block.
blocks.zh: 用户提示收缩会话 <session_history > [串行会话历史] </session_history > 现在整理引用的会话历史 。 输出完全一个 " 摘要 " ... </摘要 " 块。

blocks.en: We accept the compaction only when a non-empty <summary> block is successfully extracted. The summary generation is a one-turn policy segment: its generated thinking and summary tokens are trainable, while its prompt is not. In our implementation, it uses a maximum generation length of 16,384 16{,}384 tokens and sampling temperature 0.1 0.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们只有在成功取出非空的 " summary " 块时才接受压缩。 摘要生成是一个一回合政策部分:它产生的思维和摘要符号是可以训练的,而它的迅速则不是。 在我们的实施中,它使用最大生成长度为16,384 16{,}384个令牌和取样温度为0.1.

blocks.en: After a valid summary is produced, the preceding conversational prefix is replaced rather than appended to. The next search-agent session (i.e., normal session mentioned in § 3.2 ) starts from the same base system prompt and a continuation user message:
blocks.zh: 制作出有效摘要后,取而代之的是前面的谈话前缀而不是附加. 下一个搜索代理会话(即§3.2中提及的正常会话)从同一个基系统即时开始,并持续用户消息:

blocks.en: Continuation User Prompt of Subsequent Session of a Compaction Session This session is a continuation of a previous search session. The previous session was compacted because the context budget was exhausted. Original question: [original user question] Compacted summary of the previous session: [summary] Continue the research task using the same tool protocol. Do not restart from scratch. Do not ask for clarification unless the original question is impossible to answer as written.
blocks.zh: 继续提示用户随后的压缩会话 此会话是之前搜索会话的继续. 上届会议是紧凑的,因为上下文的预算已经用完。 原件:[原用户问 上届会议简明摘要:[摘要] 使用相同的工具协议继续研究任务. 不从头重新开始 。 除非最初的问题无法如实回答,否则不要要求澄清。

blocks.en: The continuation therefore has a fresh, shorter context containing the original task and the compressed state, while preserving the same tools and answer protocol. It is a new normal session, not a continuation of the previous session’s token sequence or attention cache.
blocks.zh: 因此,续作有一个包含原始任务和被压缩状态的新而更短的上下文,同时保留了相同的工具和解答协议. 这是一种新的正常会话,而不是前一届会议的象征顺序或注意力缓存的延续。

blocks.en: Consequently, a rollout with m m successful on-policy compactions yields m + 1 m+1 normal search-agent segments and m m compact-summary segments, for a total of 2 ​ m + 1 2m+1 trainable segments. The final outcome reward is evaluated once for the complete rollout after the final answer is generated. Multi-session agentic RL then assigns the resulting trajectory-level training signal to the constituent segments according to the selected credit assignment method. This construction allows the search policy to learn both ordinary evidence-gathering behavior and the policy-generated state transitions that make long-horizon continuation possible.
blocks.zh: 因此,用 m 成功的政策收缩方式推出 m + 1 m + 1 普通搜索代理机段和 m 压缩总机段,共计2 m + 1 2 m+1 可培训机段。 最终结果奖励在产生最后答案后被评价为全面推出。 多会场代理RL然后根据选定的信用分配方法,向组成部门分配由此产生的轨迹级培训信号. 这种构建使得搜索政策既能学习普通的证据收集行为,又能学习政策产生的状态过渡,使得长相续作成为可能.

blocks.en: C.2 Rollout in Subagent Forking
blocks.zh: C.2 试剂燃料的推出

blocks.en: This section specifies the subagent forking scenario used for the multi-session setting. Unlike context compaction, which rewrites the main agent’s context, subagent forking creates additional single-session search subagents that execute assigned subtasks and return their results to a persistent main-agent session. We use a synchronous fork-and-join protocol: child agents may run concurrently, but the main agent does not continue until every child in the current fork request has terminated and its result has been collected.
blocks.zh: 本节指定用于多会场设置的子剂活化假想. 与重写主代理上下文的上下文上下文的上下文收缩不同,子代理 forking创建了额外的单会话搜索子代理,执行指定子任务,并将结果还原为持续的主代理会话. 我们使用同步分叉和接合协议:儿童代理人可以同时运行,但主要代理人不会继续,直到当前分叉请求中的每个孩子都终止并收集了结果.

blocks.en: The main agent starts from the original user question in a single session. It receives the base search-agent system prompt in Appendix C.1 , augmented with the following delegation instruction:
blocks.zh: 主代理从一个会话中从最初的用户提问开始. 它得到附录C.1中提示的基本搜索代理系统,并辅以以下授权指示:

blocks.en: Main-agent Delegation Prompt As the main research agent, plan the investigation before executing it. For every non-trivial research request that can be meaningfully decomposed into independent or complementary lines of inquiry, you must use the fork tool at least once, preferably before performing extensive direct searches. Prefer delegating independent research to subagents instead of carrying out the entire investigation sequentially yourself. Each fork call must create between 1 and 3 subagents. Never include more than 3 subagents in one fork call. Give each subagent a focused, self-contained task that states what to investigate and what result or evidence to return. Prefer complementary, non-overlapping assignments. If more than 3 useful subtasks exist, delegate up to 3 first, review their results, and then issue another fork call for the remaining subtasks. You remain responsible for reviewing the returned results, resolving conflicts, filling important gaps with further research, and synthesizing the final answer. Do not treat subagent results as automatically correct. Forking is not limited to the beginning of the investigation. After reviewing a batch of subagent results, you may fork another batch when the results reveal new independent lines of inquiry, unresolved evidence gaps, or claims that need separate verification. Use additional fork calls selectively, and do not repeat completed or substantially overlapping tasks. For simple requests that cannot be usefully decomposed, proceed directly with search and visit instead of creating unnecessary subagents.
blocks.zh: 主要代理代表团 作为主要的研究代理人,计划调查后再执行. 对于每一个能够被有意义地分解成独立或互补的调查线的非三角研究请求,您必须至少使用一次叉子工具,最好是在进行广泛的直接搜索之前使用. 宁可将独立研究委托给副特工 而不是自己依次进行整个调查 每个分叉呼叫必须在1到3个子剂之间产生. 在一分叉呼叫中不要包含超过3个子剂. 给每个子代理人一个重点突出,自成一体的任务,说明调查的内容和返回的结果或证据. 优先执行互补、非重叠的任务。 如果存在3个以上有用的子任务,则首先授权最多3个任务,审查其结果,然后为剩余的子任务发出另一个叉调. 你们仍然负责审查返回的结果,解决冲突,通过进一步研究来填补重要的空白,并综合最后的答案。 不将亚剂结果视为自动正确。 福克不仅限于调查的开始. 在审核了一批分剂结果后,如果结果显示新的独立调查线索,未解决的证据缺口,或者需要单独核实的声称,您可以叉开另一批. 有选择地使用额外的分叉呼叫,并且不重复已完成或实质上重叠的任务. 对于无法被有益地分解的简单请求,直接进行搜索和访问,而不是创建不必要的子剂.

blocks.en: Finally, one rollout contains one main-agent session and one additional session for each completed subagent execution (i.e., subagent sessions mentioned in § 3.2 ). The main-agent segment records the fork calls and the aggregated subagent observations. Each child segment records only its own search-and-visit trajectory and is linked to the parent by its fork index.

blocks.en: We use two metrics in § 4.5 to characterize the utility of computation performed at the session level: Positive-IG Rate, which measures how frequently an executed session makes positive progress, and IG/Session, which measures the average amount of positive progress obtained from each executed session. Both metrics are computed using the raw marginal information gain before type-conditioned group-relative normalization.

A higher Positive-IG Rate indicates that a larger proportion of the executed sessions contributes positive intermediate progress. Second, the computing of IG/Session is as follows: IG/Session = ∑ τ i ∈ 𝒯 ∑ j = 1 N i max ⁡ ( r i , j Δ , 0 ) ∑ τ i ∈ 𝒯 N i . \text{IG/Session}=\frac{\sum_{\tau_{i}\in\mathcal{T}}\sum_{j=1}^{N_{i}}\max\left(r_{i,j}^{\Delta},0\right)}{\sum_{\tau_{i}\in\mathcal{T}}N_{i}}.
